translations.header: a coherent set of statements attempting to explain observed phenomena

wiktionary.gloss: A coherent statement or set of ideas that explains observed facts or phenomena and correctly predicts new facts or phenomena not previously observed, or which sets out the laws and principles of something known or observed; a hypothesis confirmed by observation, experiment etc.

examples: Knot theory classifies the mappings of a circle into 3-space.
wiktionary.gloss: A field of study attempting to exhaustively describe a particular class of constructs.

wiktionary.gloss: A set of axioms together with all statements derivable from them; or, a set of statements which are deductively closed.
